5. Rates and Variations — Rates are those set out in the agreed rate card and are fixed for the term. answer: All invoice elements — line item totals, subtotal, GST at 10%, overall total, purchase order number, and supplier ABN — are consistent with the contract requirements shown.
reference: No contract term is breached by this invoice, so the correct answer explains why the contract does not object.
